subject: Model shortlist, context-depth scan & token estimates — onboarding kickoff
messages:
From: Jane Peters <jane.peters@elarahealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@elarahealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Model shortlist & context-depth — onboarding kickoff

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the runthrough on the call today. We want to lock the model shortlist and get a first-pass token and context estimate before the implementation sprint next week. A few specifics from our side:

- Primary feature: patient-summarization for clinician workflows (one-off summaries from 2–6 notes + vitals table).
- Expected monthly active users (MAU): ~9k; target DAU for pilot: 450–600.
- Typical payload: 1–3 clinical notes per request; sample avg tokens per note ~400–700.
- Hard requirement: sensitive PHI stays in our VPC, but inference can be in Redwood Dedicated for pilot.

Questions:
1) Based on the above, what context window would you recommend (2k/4k/8k) for production summaries?
2) Can you give a 1-week token estimate for the pilot (DAU window + avg tokens/call + peaks)?
3) Do you have a model shortlist that balances latency and quality for extraction + free-text summarization?

We attached a small token sample export (see attachment) and ops contact is CC'd. Looking to confirm these numbers and schedule a 30-min technical kickoff on Thursday.

Thanks,
Jane
Director of Product
Elara Health

Attachments: elara_token_samples.csv (csv, 18KB)

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Jane Peters <jane.peters@elarahealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 23:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & context-depth — onboarding kickoff

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear samples. Putting a first-pass proposal below so the CS + implementation team have something concrete for Thursday.

Shortlist (initial candidates, tradeoffs):
- redwood-7b-qlora: best latency/cost for shorter contexts, good for structured extraction + short summaries.
- open-13b-compat (8k): higher quality on long-form synthesis and multi-note summaries, higher per-token cost and slightly higher tail latency.
- redwood-3b-compact: lowest cost for extractive tasks (patient entity/hx extraction) — useful as a fast pre-filter.

Context recommendation:
- Pilot: 4k window to comfortably stitch 2–6 notes (avg 500 tokens/note -> 3k content + metadata + prompt around 3.5–3.8k).
- Production (phase 1): keep 4k by default, offer 8k variant for complex multi-note batches with explicit sampling to keep cost predictable.

Token-volume back-of-envelope (pilot = 2 weeks; DAU conservative 500):
- Avg requests/day: 500; avg tokens/request (in+out): 5k tokens (3.5k input + 1.5k output) -> 2.5M tokens/day -> 17.5M tokens/week.
- Peak day multiplier x1.7 -> ~4.25M tokens/day on peak.

Operational notes & suggestions:
- Start with redwood-7b-qlora for latency-sensitive clinician flows and route heavy multi-note requests to open-13b-compat as fallback.
- Use prefix/KV caching for repeated lab-note headers and metadata to shave ~15–20% token cost on average.
- Batch window recommendation: 10–30ms for low-latency; can open to 50–100ms during non-critical bulk jobs.

Attached: a quick workbook with sample token math and a suggested rollout kanban (elara_model_workload_estimates.xlsx, onboarding-kanban.pdf).

Would love to confirm these numbers on the call — proposing Thu 09 Sep, 10:00 PT?

Best,
Irene Choi
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: elara_model_workload_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB); onboarding-kanban.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Jane Peters <jane.peters@elarahealth.com>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist & context-depth — onboarding kickoff

Thanks both — quick mutual action plan (MAP) to keep us aligned before sprint start. I left timeline checkboxes so we can mark during the kickoff.

MAP (pilot 2-week):
- Confirm shortlist & preferred default model (Irene): expected by Thu kickoff.
- Provide full sample payloads + redacted PHI verify (Elara): by Thu EOD.
- Provision Dedicated pool (Redwood infra): reserved 2x T4g-equivalents for pilot start week -> target latency SLA 300ms median, 1s p95.
- Canary rollout: Day 1 (10% traffic), Day 3 (50%), Day 6 (100) with rollback triggers on error rate >2% or p95 > 1.5s.
- Security/compliance: exchange SOC2 scoping doc & encryption-at-rest checklist (Redwood security): within 48 hours post-kickoff.

Sizing & ops knobs:
- If you prioritize cost-savings earlier, we recommend: redwood-3b-compact pre-filter -> redwood-7b-qlora main path -> open-13b fallback.
- Critical: set a token budget per-request (e.g., 6k cap) and a global daily token alert at 80% of expected to avoid surprises.

Open questions for kickoff:
1) Does Elara want strict per-user rate-limits or per-route?
2) Any compliance timelines that would force on-prem/private deployment instead of Dedicated?
3) Who on ops will own the KV caching keyspace mapping?

Irene/Vivek — can you bring the rough capacity configuration and cost delta slide for 7b vs 13b?

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

We confirm the pilot numbers — the 17.5M/week estimate is reasonable and we can provision buffer. Thu 10:00 PT works for our engineers — see you then.

Best,
Jane
